name: llm_council
description: Multi-Model Consensus & Council Deliberation. Broadcasts a complex problem, code architecture, or security audit in parallel to multiple LLM council members (e.g. Dahl, DeepSeek, Groq, Ollama), then automatically uses a designated Chief Justice / Synthesizer model to critique, cross-examine, and deliver the single optimal consensus solution.

prompt.description: The complex task, technical dilemma, code bug, or architectural question for council deliberation.

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt applied to all council member models.

members.description: List of council member models/providers. Defaults to active provider + fallback chain if omitted.

model.description: Model ID to query for this member.

judge.description: Chief Justice / Synthesizer configuration. Defaults to active default model.

provider.description: Provider alias from vault for the judge.

synthesis_instruction.description: Custom adjudication instructions for the Chief Justice (e.g. 'Focus on lowest latency and minimal memory footprint').
